title: Pondering Pufferpuff
statement: A slow, thoughtful pufferfish who drifts mid-tank wearing an expression of permanent mild concern, occasionally inflating into a perfect wistful balloon when an idea strikes — then deflating, unhurried, back to its philosophizing. The tank around it is a hushed twilight world of deep blue-green water, swaying moss, and a single smooth stone it has clearly been staring at for years.
